New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah — I don't have access to the CRM/sales data to pull pipeline numbers right now. If there's a specific report or dashboard I should be connected to, let me know and I can help dig into it. In the meantime, whoever owns the sales data source can likely pull the month-to-date pipeline total for you.

content.text: I responded to Sarah letting her know I don't have access to the CRM/sales data to pull pipeline numbers. I didn't want to guess or make up a figure. If you want me to be able to answer these kinds of questions, I'd need a connection to your sales data source — happy to help set that up if you point me to it.
